input.summary: Make the Deliverable licence perpetual and irrevocable, extend it to Affiliates and contractors, and allow successor transfer.
input.comment: [Playbook] Deliverables are built and paid for specifically for us, so we cannot accept a licence Vendor can revoke at will that lapses with the Order Form term; our position is a perpetual, irrevocable licence covering our Affiliates and contractors and transferable to a successor. If Vendor prefers, we can instead align this sentence with the perpetual paid-up licence already granted in Section 13.2 and the no-revocation protection in Section 13.3.

ops.oldText: Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf receive a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, reproduce, display, modify, and create derivative works from each Deliverable for Customer's business purposes, transferable to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets, and revocable only as permitted by Section 13.3.
